construction: F S0 G S1 F S2 G S3; S0..S3 partition the known solution.
proof: Every leaf is a lower-controlled upper-target shear. Every basis is a reversible nonlinear map on the lower half and an invertible linear map on the upper half. Each tree is therefore a shear by conjugation and composition. All trees and core gates commute and each tree is an involution, so F and G cancel exactly.
verification: All-input structural certificate checked against emitted gates, plus 256 deterministic bit-parallel sample inputs.
difficulty: Dense nonlinear lower-half bases grow intermediate ANFs beyond symbolic resource limits; this is a stress case, not a claim of mathematical unsolvability.
